content: Clotrimazole increases the levels or effects of elagolix by interfering with hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. The concomitant use of elagolix with strong OATP1B1 inhibitors is contraindicated. Clotrimazole increases lomitapide levels significantly by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated due to the risk of severe toxicity. Clotrimazole increases axitinib levels by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If coadministration with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors is unavoidable, monitor closely and reduce the dose of axitinib as necessary. Clotrimazole increases bosutinib levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Clotrimazole increases eliglustat levels by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. For poor or intermediate metabolizers of eliglustat, moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors are not recommended. For extensive metabolizers, reduce the eliglustat dose from 84 mg twice daily to 84 mg once daily. Clotrimazole increases entrectinib levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors are discontinued, resume the previous entrectinib dose after 3–5 elimination half-lives. Clotrimazole decreases everolimus levels or effects by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. This combination is contraindicated. Clotrimazole increases the levels or effects of infigratinib by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Clotrimazole increases the levels or effects of lurbinectedin by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Clotrimazole increases the levels or effects of intranasal midazolam by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Coadministration with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors can lead to higher systemic exposure to midazolam, potentially prolonging sedation. Clotrimazole increases the levels or effects of nirogacestat by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Clotrimazole increases the levels or effects of pacritinib by interfering with CYP2E1 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of amikacin by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of amitriptyline by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole increases the levels or effects of atogepant by interfering with OATP1B1. Modify therapy and monitor closely. The recommended dosage of atogepant with OATP inhibitors is 10 mg or 30 mg once daily. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of atorvastatin by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Clotrimazole also increases atorvastatin toxicity through other mechanisms. Use caution and monitor closely. OATP1B1 inhibitors may increase the risk of myopathy. Clotrimazole increases the levels or effects of avanafil by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. CYP3A4 inhibitors may reduce avanafil clearance, increasing systemic exposure and associated adverse events. The maximum recommended dose of avanafil is 50 mg, not to exceed once every 24 hours for patients taking moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of bazedoxifene/conjugated estrogens by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of budesonide by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole increases the levels or effects of cannabidiol by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Consider reducing the cannabidiol dose when coadministered with a moderate CYP3A4 inhibitor. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of conjugated estrogens by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of vaginal conjugated estrogens by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of cortisone by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of cyclosporine by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of deflazacort by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of dexamethasone by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of digoxin by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole increases the levels or effects of docetaxel by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of erlotinib by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of estradiol by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of synthetic conjugated estrogens by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of estropipate by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole increases the levels or effects of finerenone by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Monitor serum potassium during initiation and dosage adjustment of either finerenone or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors. Adjust finerenone dosage as needed. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of fludrocortisone by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole increases the toxicity of fluvastatin through other mechanisms. Use caution and monitor closely. OATP1B1 inhibitors may increase the risk of myopathy. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of gentamicin by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole increases the levels or effects of gepirone by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Reduce the gepirone dose by 50% when used concomitantly with a moderate CYP3A4 inhibitor. Clotrimazole increases the levels or effects of glecaprevir/pibrentasvir by decreasing metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Exercise caution when coadministering glecaprevir/pibrentasvir with OATP1B1/OATP1B3 inhibitors. Clotrimazole increases the levels of glimepiride, glipizide, and glyburide by decreasing metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of hydrocortisone by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole increases the levels or effects of ibrutinib by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. When coadministered with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors, reduce the ibrutinib dose to 280 mg daily (for B-cell malignancies) or 420 mg daily (for graft-versus-host disease). After discontinuation of the CYP3A4 inhibitor, resume the previous dose of ibrutinib. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of ifosfamide by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. The use of a CYP3A4 inhibitor may decrease ifosfamide metabolism, potentially reducing its therapeutic effects. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of imatinib by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of indinavir by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole increases the levels or effects of irinotecan and irinotecan liposomal by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole increases the levels or effects of isavuconazonium sulfate by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of ivermectin by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole increases the levels or effects of ivosidenib by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Coadministration with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase ivosidenib plasma concentrations, raising the risk of QTc prolongation. Monitor for increased risk of QTc interval prolongation. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of lapatinib by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole increases the levels of letermovir by decreasing metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Coadministration of letermovir, an OATP1B1/3 substrate, with OATP1B1/3 inhibitors may increase letermovir plasma concentrations. Clotrimazole increases the levels or effects of levamlodipine by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Coadministration with moderate and strong CYP3A inhibitors results in increased systemic exposure to amlodipine and may require dose reduction. Monitor for symptoms of hypotension and edema when amlodipine is coadministered with CYP3A inhibitors to determine the need for dose adjustment. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of loperamide by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of lovastatin by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of maraviroc by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole increases the levels or effects of mavacamten by interfering with CYP2C19 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Initiation of weak CYP2C19 inhibitors may require a decreased mavacamten dose. Clotrimazole increases the levels or effects of mefloquine by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of mestranol by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of methylprednisolone by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole increases the toxicity of momelotinib through other mechanisms. Use caution and monitor closely. OATP1B1/B3 inhibitors increase momelotinib plasma concentrations, which may raise the risk of adverse reactions. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of nelfinavir by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of oral neomycin by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of nilotinib by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole increases the levels or effects of oliceridine by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. If concomitant use is necessary, less frequent oliceridine dosing may be required. Monitor closely for respiratory depression and sedation, and titrate subsequent doses accordingly. If the inhibitor is discontinued, consider increasing the oliceridine dosage until stable drug effects are achieved. Monitor for signs of opioid withdrawal. Clotrimazole increases the levels or effects of paclitaxel and paclitaxel protein-bound by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of paliperidone by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of paromomycin by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole increases the toxicity of pitavastatin through other mechanisms. Use caution and monitor closely. OATP1B1 inhibitors may increase the risk of myopathy. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of posaconazole by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole increases the toxicity of pravastatin through other mechanisms. Use caution and monitor closely. OATP1B1 inhibitors may increase the risk of myopathy. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of prednisolone by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of prednisone by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole increases the levels or effects of rifampin through an unspecified interaction mechanism. Use caution and monitor closely. Concomitant use with cotrimoxazole increases rifampin concentrations, which may raise the risk of toxicity. Monitor for adverse reactions during coadministration. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of risperidone by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of ritonavir by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole increases the toxicity of rosuvastatin through other mechanisms. Use caution and monitor closely. OATP1B1 inhibitors may increase the risk of myopathy. Clotrimazole increases the levels or effects of ruxolitinib and ruxolitinib topical by interfering with CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of silodosin by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole increases the levels or effects of simvastatin through other mechanisms. Use caution and monitor closely. OATP1B1 inhibitors may increase the risk of myopathy. Clotrimazole decreases the levels or effects of sirolimus by acting on the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Clotrimazole increases the levels or effects of sparsentan by interfering with CYP2E1 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. No dosage adjustment is needed.
